summary: 11:30 PM ET run, published at 12:05 ET. Eight picks settled from ESPN box scores, the model's first day of real volume. Totals went 2-2: Raiders at Chargers under 43.5 won at 40 points and Eagles at Titans over 39.5 won at 44, Panthers at Falcons over 43.5 lost at 37 and Seahawks at Cardinals over 41 lost at 38. Prop leans went 2-4: Jonathan Taylor over 16.5 receiving yards and Oronde Gadsden over 12.5 receiving yards won, Courtland Sutton, Bo Nix, Alec Pierce and Patrick Mahomes lost, Mahomes by half a yard. With the longshot's quarter unit, the day is -2.37 units on the straight picks and -0.25 on the longshot. Nothing closed. NFL week 2 has the Monday night game left, so its weekly review waits.
takeaways: The prop leans' first day is the point of publishing them: six raw chances between 62% and 81% went 2-4, which is what an uncalibrated number looks like before it has a record. Two of the four losses were role misses on one game of history, Alec Pierce at 11 yards against a 61.4-yard projection and Bo Nix at 6 against 42.7. Once there are thirty or so of these, scripts/calibrate.py can shrink player chances the way it already shrinks totals, and the grade on the board will mean something.

Closing line value on the three afternoon props, from the scoreboard: Bo Nix over 17.5 closed 18.5 and Oronde Gadsden over 12.5 closed 13.5, so both beat the close by a point; Courtland Sutton matched it. Beating the close and losing the bet on the same day is the normal shape of this, and it is why the record tracks both.

gamePicks.title: Raiders at Chargers under 43.5
gamePicks.quoteNote: BetMGM's price from the 4:50 AM ET capture across five books; DraftKings, FanDuel and ESPN BET had -110 and BetRivers -109 at the same number.
gamePicks.edge: v2 total 40.2 (80% range 23.8 to 56.6). Chance of under 43.5: 54.3% (v2's raw 60.2% shrunk by its 2024-25 record against the close), against 51.9% break-even at -108: +2.4 points, +0.046u per unit.
gamePicks.cutoff: UNDER 43.5 at -108 or better. Closed to new entries at 42 or lower, or at -123 or worse at 43.5.
gamePicks.why: Settled from the ESPN box score. The number never moved off 43.5 all day and the game landed three and a half points under it.
gamePicks.risk: One result; the model earns its record over a season.

gamePicks.cutoff: OVER 41 at -108 or better. Closed to new entries at 42.5+, or at -123 or worse at 41.

gamePicks.risk: The published risk held: Darnold was ruled out after this went up, the market moved the total to 40.5 on that news, and the model did not know it.
